newsitem.title: USA: Retail orders $30 mln of MAC NYC bonds in 1st day.
newsitem.headline: Retail orders $30 mln of MAC NYC bonds in 1st day.

text.p: The Municipal Assistance Corporation for New York City got about $30 million of orders during the first day of the pre-sale period for the nearly $490 million of bonds it is selling, the lead underwriter said Monday.

"I would say it's consistent with the last couple of sales," said an official with Morgan Stanley & Co, who declined to be named. He noted that during December, when MAC sold about $677 million of bonds, it got a total of around $80 million of retail orders.
The pre-sale period for the latest sale ends on Tuesday, and the bonds are scheduled to be priced on Wednesday.
